The CSC role is developed through selection, rewards, training and accountable service. Capacity is connected to management evidence without inventing a mandatory degree. Charter coverage, merit/exam exceptions, tenure, political activity and independence each explain what the protection or restriction does.

Age is measured at appointment; candidacy is limited to the immediately preceding election. Regular terms are qualified by initial staggered terms and unexpired replacements; acting and temporary members are barred.

Coverage requires original charters for government corporations; merit survives exam exceptions; removal requires legal cause; political office holders are distinguished. Outside jobs, profession, affected-business management and government financial interests are separate tenure restrictions.

lesson-philippine-constitution-the-civil.quote: A **natural-born citizen** is a Philippine citizen from birth who needs no act to acquire or complete that citizenship.
lesson-philippine-constitution-the-civil.note: Natural-born status is defined and its constitutional exception is also taught.

lesson-philippine-constitution-the-civil.quote: This means it leads the system for managing government workers.
lesson-philippine-constitution-the-civil.note: The personnel-agency label is explained and followed by selection and career-development functions.

lesson-philippine-constitution-the-civil.quote: The first appointees under the Constitution had staggered terms: $7$ years for the Chairman, $5$ for one Commissioner, and $3$ for the other.
lesson-philippine-constitution-the-civil.note: Both initial staggered terms and vacancy appointments for the unexpired term are included.

lesson-philippine-constitution-the-civil.quote: No member may be appointed or designated in a temporary or acting capacity.
lesson-philippine-constitution-the-civil.note: The constitutional acting and temporary membership limitation is explicit.

lesson-philippine-constitution-the-civil.quote: Article IX-B of the $1987$ Constitution covers the **Civil Service Commission**, or CSC.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: It strengthens the system for choosing qualified workers and rewarding good service.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: The CSC location, personnel role, and merit-based work are now explained.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Becoming a citizen later through naturalization does not by itself make someone natural-born.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Natural-born status has a definition, exception and application examples.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: The Constitution does not require one named degree, job, or test as the sole proof.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Capacity has a plain meaning and possible evidence without an invented exclusive test.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Appointments must be based on **merit and fitness**.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: The Commission brings together training programs for workers at different levels.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Training and long-term career development now explain the CSC function.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Coverage also includes government-owned or controlled corporations with **original charters**.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: These are exceptions to the competitive-examination rule.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: A civil service officer or employee may be removed or suspended only for a cause provided by law.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Voting is different from campaigning for a candidate.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Its approved annual funding must be released automatically and regularly.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: During their tenure, members cannot hold another office or job.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Office, professional, business-management and financial-interest restrictions are separately taught and applied.
